preconditions.expression: n > 0 and m > 0 and n * m <= 2 * 10**5 and n * m % 2 == 0
preconditions.description: The board dimensions n and m are positive integers with even total cells (n*m ≤ 200,000).

preconditions.expression: all(c in {'U', 'D', 'L', 'R'} for row in board for c in row)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the board is represented by one of the characters U, D, L, or R.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == m for row in board) and len(board) == n
preconditions.description: The board is an n × m grid of characters, with each row having exactly m characters.

preconditions.expression: all(any((i, j) == (i + di, j + dj) and board[i][j] == opposite[board[i + di][j + dj]] for di, dj in [(0, 1), (1, 0)] if 0 <= i + di < n and 0 <= j + dj < m) for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
preconditions.description: The tiling is valid: every domino half has a matching counterpart adjacent horizontally or vertically, where opposite is {'U': 'D', 'D': 'U', 'L': 'R', 'R': 'L'}.

postconditions.description: The output is the number of distinct pairs of free cells (photos) that can be obtained by removing exactly one domino and performing any sequence of valid moves.
Each photo corresponds to exactly two distinct free cells on the board.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= i < n and 0 <= j < m for (i, j) in free_cells for free_cells in reachable_pairs)
postconditions.description: All free cells in any photo are valid board coordinates.

postconditions.expression: all(connected(free_cells[0], free_cells[1], board) for free_cells in reachable_pairs)
postconditions.description: The two free cells in any photo are reachable from each other via valid domino moves, where connected(i1, j1, i2, j2, board) means there exists a sequence of moves transforming the initial free cells (after removing one domino) to (i1, j1) and (i2, j2) while preserving the domino adjacency rule.
